response.justification: Bogdan is a technically strong and versatile individual contributor with deep experience in developer tools, testing frameworks, and low-level systems, but his resume shows no evidence of people management or formal team leadership experience. All roles listed are IC titles (Senior/Staff Software Developer/Engineer), with no mention of managing direct reports, conducting performance reviews, or leading organizational change, which are core, non-negotiable requirements for this management role.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools, test frameworks (Trial, Fluent-Asserts), and CI/CD infrastructure
Strong technical breadth across languages, systems, and platforms (web, mobile, embedded, low-latency services)
History of knowledge-sharing via workshops, talks, and mentoring-adjacent activities
concerns: No evidence of formal people management experience (no direct reports, performance reviews, or team leadership mentioned)
No indication of leading organizational change or strategic roadmap ownership at a management level
Career trajectory remains consistently IC-focused (Senior/Staff Developer) despite 15+ years of experience

key_factors.factor: Strong developer tools and testing infrastructure background
